environment.description: Spring Boot 2.7 application deployed on EC2 instances behind a public-facing ALB with sticky sessions enabled. Session cookies use SameSite=None for cross-subdomain SSO compatibility. ALB security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. Spring Security CSRF protection is explicitly disabled via http.csrf().disable() in SecurityConfig. The SQS queue is accessed via public SQS endpoint. Users authenticate via session cookies set with HttpOnly but without SameSite=Strict.
